title: Beef-Free Beef Stir Fry
description: A vegetarian alternative to a classic beef stir fry. Using portobello mushrooms to mimic the texture of beef, this dish is quick and easy to make.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the stir-fry sauce and soy sauce, and stir to combine.
Return the mushrooms to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the shredded cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions if desired.
Serve with additional stir-fry sauce on the side, if desired.
